scenes.name: STREET CORNER
lines: Step onto Street Corner—no studio camera, no rented ballroom, just a living three-dimensional lobby.
踏上街角前厅——没有摄影棚，没有租来的宴会厅，只有一座实时运转的三维会场。
At the reception desk, Concierge Donna greets every visitor against a thirty-question verified press bank.
前台处，礼宾 Donna 依据三十题核验问答库迎接每一位来宾。

scenes.name: SEAT LOCK
lines: Behind her rise six concentric theater rings: exactly one thousand one hundred eight seats, protected by an atomic booking lock.
她身后是六圈同心剧场：恰好一千一百零八个座位，由原子锁保护、目标零撞座。
When the theater fills, guest one thousand one hundred nine flows seamlessly to the live stream.
当剧场坐满，第一千一百零九位观众将无缝分流至直播流。

scenes.name: FLOWER TOWN
lines: Across the square in Flower Town, Blossom tends eighteen numbered flower-basket stands.
广场对面的花店里，小花照看着十八座编号花篮展台。
Pick a bouquet, sign a card, and watch your basket materialize along the promenade before the keynote begins.
选一束花、写下贺卡，开场前就能看见花篮落座在会场长廊。
